Every claim, metric, pro-tip and operator gate carries timestamped inline attribution to the practitioner channel and video it came from.

flow: Run the five-year lookback test and weigh projected recovery against filing expense; if the math is not positive, do not file.
Trace a single shipment from purchase order to import, through inventory, to export before applying for waiver of prior notice.
Test export records against hard-copy documents, remove foreign-to-foreign moves, cancelled orders and short shipments, and reconcile every claim line to ACE down to unit of measure.
File claims the same day the privilege application is submitted to lock the 5-year look-back, and assign an owner to every CBP information request.
Archive courier proof-of-delivery as goods move, segregate commingled returns, and destroy goods only at a scheduled, witnessed event with a disinterested third party and certificate.
Stage a mock audit for desk reviews, pivot denials to an alternative 1313 subsection before protesting, and pursue accelerated payment for refunds in about 30 days.
